summary: Oklo Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an at-the-market equity distribution agreement entered September 11, 2026 with Goldman Sachs, BofA, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Barclays, Cantor Fitzgerald, Guggenheim, Canaccord Genuity and B. Riley Securities as sales agents, covering up to $1.0 billion of Class A common stock sold at prevailing market prices at the Company's discretion. Agents receive up to 1.5% commission. This is an ordinary shelf-style ATM takedown rather than a special situation; watch dilution pace, selling price floors and any accretion to Oklo's nuclear pipeline funding plans.
